title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: The Year-of-Service Rate Used in Rate-Year Corrections
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — year-of-service rate for the rate-year correction.** The year-of-service rate the rate-year correction compares against follows the calendar year in which the corrected block's days were furnished: a corrected block whose last service date falls in 2026 or later is compared against 217.00 a day, a corrected block whose last service date falls in 2025 against 209.50 a day, and any other corrected block, which the record test limits to one whose last service date falls in 2024, against 204.00 a day.

The year is read from the last service date on the corrected block's booked-days entry.

| Last service date of the corrected block | Year-of-service rate compared against |
|---|---|
| In 2026 or any later year | 217.00 a day |
| In 2025 | 209.50 a day |
| Any other — within the record test, a date in 2024 | 204.00 a day |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Last service date 30 April 2025: 209.50. Last service date 28 February 2026: 217.00.
- Last service date 31 December 2024: 204.00. Last service date 1 January 2025: 209.50.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a resident's charge recorded 7 days at 209.50 for a corrected block whose last service date falls in 2024, resident share 100 percent: the recorded figure is 1466.50 and the year-of-service figure is 7 times 204.00, 1428.00; the difference is 38.50.
